name: Reconnaissance & OSINT
tagline: Passive + active discovery: subdomains, DNS, historical data, people, leaks, and exposed assets.

tools.name: Amass
tools.desc: OWASP-recommended, querying dozens of sources for active/passive subdomains; builds graph and flagship-level relationships between discovered assets.
tools.when: Full-scope startup: let it run long against a big target while you work other recon.

tools.name: Subfinder
tools.desc: Fast passive-only subdomain discovery from 30+ sources (APIs optional, works well without them).
tools.when: The daily driver when you want speed over depth, or when API keys are scarce.

tools.name: crt.sh
tools.desc: Transparency-log search over issued TLS certificates; zero-install, browser or curl.
tools.when: Instant no-setup check; great for history not visible via simple DNS queries.

tools.name: dnsx
tools.desc: Fast multi-threaded DNS resolver built to verify a big list of candidate subdomains (A/AAAA/CNAME/TXT).
tools.when: After enumeration: confirm which hosts resolve and grab their records in one pass.

tools.name: httpx
tools.desc: Probes a list of hosts and returns live status codes, technologies, titles, and fingerprints.
tools.when: Convert hundreds of DNS names into a live-but-quiet target list before tooling takes over.

tools.name: SecurityTrails
tools.desc: Passive DNS history and subdomain API; free tier without keys.
tools.when: See records that no longer resolve but reveal old infrastructure (staging, dev).

tools.name: VirusTotal DNS
tools.desc: Relations/passive-dns endpoints to map infrastructure and finding subdomains via historical resolution.
tools.when: Correlate IP→domains and flag anomalies when you already have an API key.

tools.name: naabu
tools.desc: Fast SYN port scanner (projectdiscovery) focused on top 100/1000 ports; integrates cleanly with httpx/nuclei.
tools.when: Quick-but-broad port discovery feeding the rest of the pipeline.

tools.name: Masscan
tools.desc: Most-port-fastest scanner; emits results in a format easily piped into nmap or naabu.
tools.when: Scan the entire internet range of your target (or very large CIDRs) quickly.

tools.name: nmap
tools.desc: The classic suite: port scan, OS/service detection, and scripting engine (NSE).
tools.when: Deep service identification and vulnerability scripts on a small, targeted set of hosts.

tools.name: RustScan
tools.desc: Rust-based scanner that sweeps all ports in seconds then hands specifics to nmap.
tools.when: When you want all-ports coverage faster than nmap's default and the pipeline output into nmap.
